title: 16 · Split chains on resize
objective: Redistribute Nodes across new buckets without losing data.
instructions: resize(old) returns a bucket array with double the capacity.
Walk every Node of the old array; move it to the new array using key % newCapacity (keys are non-negative).
No duplicates, no missing Nodes, and no cycles.
hints: Save the old next reference before changing current.next.
The new array starts all null; you can add Nodes at the front of each bucket.
No need to create new Node objects; relink the old Nodes.
